newsitem.title: UK: Barratt says current home sales up 21 pct.
newsitem.headline: Barratt says current home sales up 21 pct.

text.p: British housebuilder Barratt Developments Plc unveiled a 30 percent rise in half-year profits on Wednesday which it said marked the end of seven years of famine in the British market.

New sales reservations so far this year were up 21 percent on a year ago, it said, and the company now had 200 million pounds worth of advance sales in hand. "Trading conditions in the six months ended December 31 effectively brought to an end the the seven-year long recession in the UK housing market," said chairman Sir Lawrie Barratt.
Pre-tax profits for the six months to end-December rose to 24.8 million pounds from 19.1 million last time on sales up 12 percent at 311.2 million pounds.
